items.source: Implementations adapt a From and expose typed join methods for singular and collection-valued attributes as well as map-valued attributes. The methods accept PropertyReference instances to avoid string-based attribute navigation.
items.translation: 实现会适配一个From，并为单值属性、集合值属性以及映射值属性暴露强类型的连接方法。这些方法接受PropertyReference实例，以避免基于字符串的属性导航。
